subject: Bridge to Success: CureGrid onboarding roles & timeline

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: CureGrid bridge to success — quick context and asks

Team —

Quick thread to hand the deal to CS and surface a couple of risks that I want on our radar before kickoff. High level: CureGrid signed yesterday for Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity + private control plane) — committed MRP for 12 months. Primary users will be two product squads and a platform team that needs VPC peering and SOC2 evidence.

Key commercials:
- Contract: DG-2027-0458 (signed 2027-04-19)
- Start date: target go-live 2027-06-07 (pilot first week of June)
- Committed GPUs: 4x A100 equivalent nodes, burst pool allowed for first 30 days
- Billing owner: Alyssa Chen (procurement) — invoice cadence monthly

Customer contacts:
- Sanjay Rao (Director of AI, CureGrid) — technical lead
- Alyssa Chen (Procurement) — billing/PO
- Liam O'Neill (Platform Lead) — network & infra

Top risks I flagged in sales: 
1) Network/VPC peering — CureGrid requires static egress IPs and private peering; network team told me they need a completed network spec at least 3 weeks before pilot.
2) SOC2 evidence — procurement asked for attestation of data handling; they might request a signed DPIA for certain data flows.
3) Model sizing mismatch — they plan to run mixed workloads (chat + embeddings) during pilot; we should validate batch/throughput expectations.

Asks/owners: 
- Monica: you to be the CS lead and own pilot plan + success criteria. Primary CS owner for kickoff and weekly cadences.
- Vivek: can you take network/infra coordination with CureGrid and our infra SREs (I can intro to their Liam)?
- Tessa: please own the internal rollout checklist and coordinate training materials for product squads.

A few deliverables to start this week:
- Draft pilot success criteria doc (Monica) — due 2027-04-23 EOD
- Network spec template filled by CureGrid + review (Vivek) — target by 2027-04-28
- SOW annex (technical appendix) — attached (CureGrid_SOW_v1.pdf) — please review and flag any ops constraints

I'm looping out to the customer now with a one-line intro and timeline tomorrow morning. Flag anything I missed.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — I’ll take lead on the pilot. Quick notes from my side: 

1) Pilot success criteria — I want to capture both qualitative and quantitative measures:
   - Latency p95 under 400ms for chat median payloads
   - Token cost per 1k requests below our target benchmark (I'll run a synthetic using their expected mix)
   - Product team sign-off on two integration flows and one regression test set

2) Training: recommend two 60-minute sessions (one ops, one product) during week 0 and office hours in week 1.

3) Dependencies: 
   - Need a list of approved sample data for the regression tests (redacted where needed) — Sanjay, can you confirm?
   - Need SRE contact (Vivek) to triage peering and static IP constraints.

I’ll draft the pilot success doc and share comments in the Drive link by Fri (2027-04-23). Also found one small gap in the SOW: the doc references a 4-week stabilization window but doesn’t specify runbook ownership — I’ll add an owner column.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

- Static IPs: we can accept a small NATed egress pool but need an SLA on address stability for the pilot window. Our platform team manages strict firewall rules.
- Data for regression tests: we can provide a redacted corpus of 2k messages and an embeddings sample; I'll send a secure link to Monica by EOD Wed (2027-04-28).
- Training: Ops session should include an overview of the KV cache behavior and how to manage tokenization costs.

Availability for kickoff week (first week of June): June 7-9 we can commit to daily 30-minute syncs.

Forwarding Alyssa to sync billing PO timing — Alyssa, can you confirm when we will issue the PO?
